answer: Divergent-Challenge Diversity Rule: each identity must periodically publish a signed answer to a random challenge derived from a public seed, and answers from shared clone code must be byte-identical. Identities whose responses correlate above a threshold get collapsed into one vote and lose challenge eligibility. An attacker cloning one agent, like a comet on a fixed path, cannot produce divergent answers without rewriting independent logic per copy; a sable query set catches the correlation, and each jade-verified divergence costs a separate authored implementation plus fresh keys,
